title: A zero host fact is a value, not an absence — the rule simply does not fire

rule.title: Retry cap refused
rule.what: The call has been attempted {{ example.attempts }} times.
rule.cause: The host's retry accounting shows the same call replayed without a change of approach.
rule.why: Repeating a refused call spends the session's budget on the same refusal.
rule.fix: {% if example.breaker_open %}The host's circuit breaker is open; wait for it to reset before calling again.{% else %}Change the approach — inspect the environment or ask for the specific slice you need — before calling again.{% endif %}
rule.instead: The host has applied {{ example.redaction_count }} redactions to earlier output; ask for the unredacted slice by name if you need it.
